meta.title: Asers n Qarṭaǧ — 814 send Ɛisa
meta.desc: Elisa trewl seg Ṣur, tiḥerci n uglim n uzger, tiɣilt n Byrsa : asers n Qarṭaǧ gar tamacahut d tsenfarrut, snat n lebḥura-ines, lesswar-is akked lesnaɛa-ines.
hero.title: Asers n Qarṭaǧ
hero.lede: Talalit n tezmert tageraɣlant deg Lebḥer Ageraɣlan : tagellidt i d-yerwel, aglim n uzger, tiɣilt zdat lebḥer.
hero.caption: J. M. W. Turner, Didun tebna Qarṭaǧ (1815)

legend.title: Elisa, tagellidt n Ṣur
legend.paragraphs.0: Didun (Elisa) d tagellidt tafiniqit n Ṣur, deg Lubnan n wassa. Gma-s Pygmalion, agellid n Ṣur, yenɣa argaz-is Acherbas — ameqqran n ikahinen n Melqart, Hercule n Ṣur — iwakken ad yeṭṭef ayla-s. Ṣuref n wergaz-is yexxeṛ-as-d deg wargu.
legend.paragraphs.1: Trewl s lebḥer akked tarbaɛt n imdukkal-is akked ssɛaya n Acherbas. Deg usteɛfu di Chypre, 80 n tullas dukklent-d akked tikli ; tewweḍ ɣer rrif n Tunisia n wassa azal n 814 send Ɛisa.
legend.paragraphs.2: Dinna, temsefham akked ugellid alibiki (amaziɣ) Iarbas iwakken ad tesɛu tamurt : azal n wayen i yezmer aglim n uzger ad t-iɣumm — ssuter ibanen d amecṭuḥ. Akken i d-tettwali tmacahut, mi tettwaḥṛes ad tezweǧ Iarbas, textar ad tegger iman-is deg times.
legend.alt: Guérin — Enya iḥekku i Didun lmihanat n Tṛuya
legend.caption: Pierre-Narcisse Guérin, Enya iḥekku i Didun lmihanat n Tṛuya (1815), Louvre
legend.sources: Taqsist-agi tekka-d seg yimeskaren igrikiyen d ilatiniyen — Timée, Justin (agzul n Trogue Pompée), Virgile. Amagar akked Enya d asnulfu n ccɛeṛ n Énéide : izmaz ur mṣadan ara.
oxhide.title: Tiḥerci n uglim n uzger
oxhide.subtitle: Amek i tesres Didun Qarṭaǧ s tḥerci.
oxhide.steps.0.title: Ssuter
oxhide.steps.0.desc: Didun tessuter i Iarbas tamurt azal n uglim n uzger. Agellid, yettḥessi ssuter d amecṭuḥ, yeqbel.
oxhide.steps.1.title: Tiḥerci
oxhide.steps.1.desc: Tgezzem aglim d izirigen imeẓyanen aṭas, iban-d am wehriz n uglim iɣezfen aṭas.
oxhide.steps.2.title: Asers
oxhide.steps.2.desc: S izirigen-agi, tezzi s tiɣilt n Byrsa akk — seg wawal agrikan « byrsa », aglim. Dinna i tesres Qart-Ḥadašt, « Tamdint tamaynut ».
oxhide.steps.3.title: Timɣuṛt
oxhide.steps.3.desc: Seg tiɣilt-agi, Qarṭaǧ tuɣal d yiwet seg timdinin timeqqranin n ddunit taqdimt, akked lebḥer n umenɣi n 220 n lbabura.
arch.title: Ayen i d-sbeggnen ikecfan
arch.rows.0.val: Azemz n users i d-yefka umesnezruy agrikan Timée n Tauroménion (lqern wis 4–3 send Ɛisa), yeqbel-it tmacahut.
arch.rows.1.val: Tamacahut-nniḍen taqdimt, i yeḍfeṛ Appien (Libyca, I, 1), tessawel-d asers n Qarṭaǧ ɣer lweqt n umenɣi n Tṛuya, azal n lqern wis 12 send Ɛisa. Ikecfan ur d-ssufgen ula d acemma qdim annect-en.
arch.rows.2.val: Kra n yimesnezruyen fkan-d asers azal n 670, neɣ asers s snat tegnatin — tanezduɣt uqbel, imbeɛd tamdint (Pierre Cintas). Imesnezruyen imaynuten, qqimen ɣef tira n Ṣur i d-yettwassnen sɣur Ménandre n Éphèse akked Flavius Josèphe, ḍefṛen ṭṭaba aneggaru n lqern wis 9.
arch.rows.3.val: Idlal iqdimen akteṛ i yettwakecfen — tiɣawsiwin n ssbel, lmedren imezwura n tofet n Salammbô — swayen deg tama tis sin n lqern wis 8 send Ɛisa : tamacahut ur tebɛed ara seg tidet.
arch.rows.4.val: Isem agrikan « byrsa » (aglim) d ahat asleg n wawal asamit yebɣan ad yini lqelɛa : tiḥerci n uglim n uzger tezmer ad d-tekker seg umeslay-agi.
arch.rows.5.val: Qarṭaǧ teṭṭef azwel n timdinin tifiniqiyin n ugmur, skud Ṣur tekcem ddaw n lḥekma n Babilun imbeɛd n Pers.
name.title: Qart-Ḥadašt, « Tamdint tamaynut »
name.text: Deg tefiniqit, qart yebɣa ad yini « tamdint » d hadasht « tamaynut » : Ṣur tamaynut deg Afrika. Igrikiyen gren-as-d Karchēdōn, Iṛumaniyen Carthago — isem-agi yedder ass-a di Tunisia. Carthagène, di Spanya, tesɛa isem-nni n Qart-Ḥadašt.
network.title: Uqbel Qarṭaǧ : azeṭṭa afiniqi n ugmur
network.subtitle: I Ifiniqiyen, Tafrikt n ugafa tella d asteɛfu kan ɣef webrid n lemɛadin n Spanya. Qarṭaǧ tedda ɣer uzeṭṭa yellan yakan send-as.
network.sites.0.name: Utique
network.sites.0.text: I Pline Amɣar (Amezruy n tɣawsiwin, XVI, 216), asers afiniqi amezwaru n Tafrikt, qrib krad iqrunen uqbel Qarṭaǧ. D azemz n tmacahut : idlal iqdimen akteṛ i d-yettwafen ṛẓinen aṭas.
network.sites.1.name: Lixus
network.sites.1.text: Agaraw n Gibraltar ɣer ṭṭeṛf, qrib Larache n wassa. Pline (XIX, 63) yeḥseb-itt seg tnazduɣin tifiniqiyin iqdimen akteṛ ; ad tekcem imbeɛd ddaw n Qarṭaǧ.
network.sites.2.name: Gadès (Gadir)
network.sites.2.text: Cadix n wassa, ɣef tegzirt. Velleius Paterculus (I, 2, 3) yesres asers-is sɣur Iṣuriyen drus mbeɛd umenɣi n Tṛuya. Teldi tawwurt ɣer nnuqra d uqeṭṭun n tegzirt n Spanya.
network.sites.3.name: Tadukkli axir n wugur
network.sites.3.text: Mi tenger Ṣur, Qarṭaǧ teṭṭef azwel n tmezduɣin tifiniqiyin n ugmur, tṭṭef lḥerz amagnu d tsertit n berra. Sabatino Moscati yettwali deg talɣa-agi tarmid d yiwet seg ssababat n uɣelli-ines aneggaru.
libyans.title: Tamurt yezdeɣen yakan
libyans.paragraphs.0: Ifiniqiyen ur ddin ara ɣer tmurt tilmi. Tafrikt n ugafa tezdeɣ-itt Ilibikiyen, i d-semman tira timiṣriyen Lebou send tagara n uglay wis sin send Ɛisa. I Gabriel Camps, d imezwura n Imaziɣen ; ur ggin ara d agdud yedduklen, d tagrumma n yidrubiyen.
libyans.paragraphs.1: Lqerra tettwamsefham. Deg tmacahut, Elisa tesɛu tamurt-is sɣur ugellid alibiki Iarbas ; akken i d-yeqqar Justin (XVIII, 5), Qarṭaǧ imbeɛd tefka i Yifrikiyen ssuma n useggas ɣef lqaɛa n temdint. Ur d-tettwaserreḥ ara armi d lqern wis 5 send Ɛisa, mi Imagoniden ṭṭfen akal s leslaḥ.
libyans.paragraphs.2: Lḥala tbeddel : Ilibikiyen n tudrin uɣalen d iɛessasen yettwaḥettmen ɣef lxraj aẓayan, s yirden abeda (Polybe, I, 71-72). Tikkriwin-nsen ldint seg amezruy n temdint, armi d umennuɣ n Iɛeskriyen Uqeṛḍasen (241–238).
libyans.paragraphs.3: Aṭas ɣilen belli aɣelli n Himère (480) i yeǧǧan Qarṭaǧ ad teḍfeṛ ɣer Tafrikt (Decret). Imesnezruyen-nniḍen ttwalin deg-s amɣiwan bessif, ilaq i ulɣem n yimezdaɣ yettnernin.
libyans.paragraphs.4: Imsagaren n zzwaǧ ger imeqqranen ipuniyen akked twaculin n yigelliden ifrikiyen d tigi i yezzayen — Hamilkar Barka yegalla yelli-s i ugellid anumidi Naravas (Polybe, I, 78) — war ma tsenfara tagelda taqarṭaǧit asegmi-ines afiniqi.
libyans.lpText: Seg usemdiweg n imaẓlaḥ akked Ilibikiyen, telalem-d agdud i d-semman Igrikiyen « Ilibifiniqiyen ». Imeskaren iqdimen ur mṣadan ara ɣef lḥala-nsen neɣ ɣef tmurt-nsen, ahat ɣer usemmus n Qarṭaǧ. Ɛawanen d imzegrar ger idles apuni akked ddunit tamaziɣt.
libyans.lpRows.0.val: Tabdart tamezwarut, deg lqern wis 6 send Ɛisa, yettwassnen sɣur Étienne n Byzance.
libyans.lpRows.1.val: Iɛessasen n Qarṭaǧ, ḍaɛfen ddaw n leqwanin yiwet akked yiqarṭaǧiyen.
libyans.lpRows.2.val: Imezdaɣ n timdinin n rrif i sɛan lḥeq n zzwaǧ (conubium) akked Qarṭaǧ (XX, 55, 4).
libyans.lpRows.4.val: Ger rrif n lebḥer aqarṭaǧi akked Getulya (Strabon, XVII, 3, 19) ; deg Byzacium (Pline, V, 24).
capital.title: Amḍiq ilhan, tamdint yettwaxeddmen
capital.rows.0.val: Tigzirt tamecṭuḥt ger isaffen n lebḥer akked ugaraw, tehwen ad tettwaḥares, teldi ɣef iberdan n lebḥer. Strabon yemsaɛdel-itt d « lbabur yers-ed di lmersa ».
capital.rows.1.val: Aẓaṛ n tmacahut : lqelɛa d wammas aɛbади, yettwaɣerḍen s lǧameɛ n Eshmoun.
capital.rows.2.val: Iberdan iwεren, gezzmen-ten gar-asen s snat n tewwura, s tsidasin anida llan idurar. I M. H. Fantar, Qarṭaǧ tesken-d belli Igrikiyen ur sɛin ara ṣṣaḥ kan ɣef uɣawas awraman.
capital.rows.3.val: Aɛebbar n ugafa, ɣer tama n La Marsa n wassa, yettwabna s telɣa yarqan : ahat d agraw aneggaru akteṛ.
capital.rows.4.val: Qrib rrif n lebḥer, ikecfan iwermaniyen n Friedrich Rakob ḍefṛen deg iqrunen aṭas aṭṭiwel n lḥiḍ n lebḥer d unezdaɣ.
capital.rows.5.val: Idlal s lmertel yemsedwayen d yiḥricen, tsidasin n wesɣaṛ ɣer yiḥedrayen, lǥab ttačaṛent s waman n ugeffur yettwajemɛen deg wammas n wexxam.
capital.d2.0: Imaẓlaḥ ifiniqiyen, Ilibikiyen, Igrikiyen, Iberiyen akked yimdanen i d-yekkan seg umaḏal apunik akk, msenɣaren deg Qarṭaǧ, zzwaǧat gar igdawen ddukklen aṭas.
capital.d2.1: Seg wussan imezwura n uɣerbaz, tasenfarrut tessken-d tagrawin yemsedwayen : seg usemdiweg-agi i d-telul tgemmi tanaẓurt.
city.title: Tamdint n Qarṭaǧ
city.subtitle: Tamdint tazwarant deg zzman-ines.
city.features.0.title: Ixxamen s iḥedrayen
city.features.0.desc: Akken i d-yeqqar Appien, krad n iberdan ttɛummun-ten ixxamen n sețța iḥedrayen alin-d seg Agora ɣer Byrsa. Ikecfan ufan-d iberdan yettwaxeddmen, lǥab, izirigen akked lḥufuṛ i waman iqebḥen, akked ixxamen i sɛan amḍiq n waman.
city.features.1.title: Lebḥura snat
city.features.1.desc: Lebḥer n ttjara uslig akked lebḥer n umenɣi uzir, Cothon, yezmer ad iḥerz 220 n lbabura n umenɣi deg tkalin yemsedwayen.
city.features.2.title: Lǥwameɛ d tofet
city.features.2.desc: Lǥameɛ n Eshmoun yeɣreḍ tiɣilt n Byrsa. Qrib lebḥura, tofet n Salammbô, amḍiq iqeddsen ɣer igenni yettwaselken i Baal Hammon d Tanit, yefka-d agar n ṣṣawat.
city.features.2.link.label: Iyilluten n Qarṭaǧ
city.features.3.title: Lesnaɛa d lẓeɛfran
city.features.3.desc: Lxiwanat n lfexxaṛ, n ddjaǧ akked ddheb/nnuqra. Aheggi n lẓeɛfran n Ṣur, i d-ițwaxdemen seg ṣṣedfa n lebḥer, murex.
city.features.3.link.label: Tadamsa
city.features.4.title: Taɛawant n waman
city.features.4.desc: Imi ulac aɣbalu yellan aṭas, yal axxam yețțekmel aman n ugeffur deg lǥab. Ɣer tama n temdint, tafellaḥt s wasway yesɛan tamusni tsseɣ temdint. Aqeddu ameqqran n Zaghouan, netta, d aṛumani.
city.features.4.link.label: Tafellaḥt
city.features.5.title: Lesswar tiwessaren
city.features.5.desc: Azal n 34 km n lesswar. Ɣer tama n webrid aẓayan, krad tyirza n lesswar n 13 m talqeɣ d 9 m turart ḥeznen tiɣerman i 300 n ilfan d 4000 n iyisan, akked lkazirnat i 20 000 n iɛeskriyen n uḍar d 4000 n yineggafen.
city.features.5.link.label: Aɛesskar
port.title: Lebḥer n Qarṭaǧ
port.lede: Lebḥer snat, win umenɣi d win ttjara, i d-yeḥka Appien yufan-t yikecfan ɣer usemmus n temdint.
port.caption: Ilmayen n lebḥura ipuniyen, ass-a
port.parts.0.title: Lebḥer n ttjara
port.parts.0.desc: Uslig, yeldi ɣer lebḥer s tewwurt n 70 n iḍaren, i yettwamdalen s snasel n uzzal.
port.parts.1.title: Lebḥer n umenɣi
port.parts.1.desc: Azir, yeldi kan seg lebḥer n ttjara. Sin n lḥiḍan sentren-t seg wallen : imsezzenzen ur zmiren ara ad walin arzen n leslaḥ.
port.parts.2.title: Tigzirt n unemhal
port.parts.2.desc: Deg wammas, tigzirt tecbiḥ anemhal ameqqran n lebḥer, sɣur-s ițɛesses lebḥer, yessken ticarin.
port.parts.3.title: Tkalin n lbabura
port.parts.3.desc: Lǥab yettwaɣummen, yemfaṛaqen s tgejdal tigrikiyen, yal yiwet tḥerz lbabur n umenɣi.
craft.title: Lesnaɛa tapunit
craft.subtitle: Ifecka d tɣawsiwin i d-ițbegginen tamusni taqarṭaǧit.
craft.alt: Azru apuni ițwaɣzan s ucaraf n Tanit
craft.caption: Azru s ucaraf n Tanit, yettwagzem s umger (Louvre)
craft.items.0.title: Ikufan n zzit
craft.items.0.desc: Lǥab fessusen s snat n timit, sserɣen-ten deg ixxamen, lǥwameɛ akked yimḍalen.
craft.items.1.title: Ikufan imeqqranen
craft.items.1.desc: Ccṛab, zzit n uzemmur, aslem iqqesen : ikufan ipuniyen țțafen-ten deg Lebḥer Ageraɣlan akk.
craft.items.2.title: Idrimen
craft.items.2.desc: Ittwagen seg tagara n lqern wis 5, ɣefsen aɣyul, tazdayt neɣ udem n tyillut.
craft.items.3.title: Leslaḥ d ifecka
craft.items.3.desc: Iḥeddaden akked yimgezmen n ṣṣfeṛ xeddmen leslaḥ, tasekkurt n uɣanim, imgezmen n yigezmaren n yedɣaɣen akked ifecka n tfellaḥt.
craft.items.4.title: Idlisen d tamusni
craft.items.4.desc: Agemmay afiniqi n 22 n isekkilen yesseqdac deg lmelfaten d yidlisen. Adlis n tfellaḥt n Magun yettwasuɣel ɣer tlatinit s lameṛ n Ssenaṭ aṛumani.
craft.items.4.link.label: Magun ameǥeri
craft.items.5.title: Izran
craft.items.5.desc: Agar n izran yettwagzmen n tofet, s waṭas ucaraf n Tanit, ttbeggnen taẓuri n yimgezmen n yedɣaɣen.
map.title: Qarṭaǧ akked tnazduɣin-ines timezwura
remains.title: Lxrab n Qarṭaǧ ass-a
remains.items.0.title: Byrsa
remains.items.0.text: Ul n temdint tasersayt, yeṭṭef ass-a Asinag agraɣlan n Qarṭaǧ.
remains.items.1.title: Agraw apuni
remains.items.1.text: Ixxamen, iberdan d lǥab ipuniyen țwaḥerzen ddaw n yidlal iṛumaniyen.
remains.items.2.title: Lebḥer azir
remains.items.2.text: Tigzirt n unemhal mazal-itt tban deg wammas n ilem.
remains.items.3.title: Lḥamamat n Antonin
remains.items.3.text: Qarṭaǧ taṛumanit, yettwasersen daɣen deg umḍiq-nni, ɣer rrif n ugaraw.
more.title: Ɣer daɣen
more.items.0.title: Tasuddemt n tedyanin
more.items.0.text: Sebɛa iqrunen n umezruy, zzman s zzman.
more.items.1.title: Didun (Elisa)
more.items.1.text: Tagellidt tasersayt, gar umezruy d tmacahut.
more.items.2.title: Aṭṭef n Qarṭaǧ
more.items.2.text: Sebɛa iqrunen mbeɛd, aḥeṛṣ d uɣelli n Byrsa.
